title: Rapa Nui genomes: no collapse, early American contact
summary: Genomes of 15 Rapanui people who lived 1670-1950 show about 10% Indigenous American ancestry from contact in the 13th-15th centuries, and no population collapse before Europeans arrived.
why: Supports pre-Columbian contact and challenges the popular 'ecocide' collapse story.

notes.problem: 'Overturns' overclaims; source: the data 'did not contain any evidence of a population collapse in the 1600s' (one genomic study).
